Recorded claim:
D210764 explicitly requested {?object} rather than {object?}. The accepted shared browser-test helper applies {?Array}, {?object}, {?RegExp}, and {?string}. This is a review-backed syntax rule for nullable JSDoc in this JavaScript test area, beyond formatting.
